parameters.name: BindId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the bound service.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ProbeId
parameters.description:
The probe ID.

>  You can call the [ListHoneypotProbe](~~ListHoneypotProbe~~) operation to query the IDs of probes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas delete-honeypot-probe-bind --probe-id aa234650-cfcf-4e25-b61f-c58f603f0000 --bind-id aa20815f-f0f3-4e3b-8e13-557717420000 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
